name: feedback
title: Feedback
description: Feedback from the chat composer: one Feedback button starts feedback mode on the application page (hover, click to pin a numbered note, hold ⌥ to use the app, optional voice), and one chip carries the notes to the next message. FeedbackBar, NoteBubble, FeedbackChip with its review, useComposerFeedback for the pi-chat composer, and PickerOverlay styles. Optional, not mounted by default: PointButton, AnnotateSheet, FeedbackList and FeedbackReport. Picking, masking, anchoring and placement stay in @hachej/boring-feedback/page and /ui, so restyling cannot weaken them.
